questions: Baseboard: your DWG 252258 REV 1 has no baseboard - panels from 5 to 3193 above the floor. On site the walls are prepared for a STONE baseboard (by others), as Main Kitchen / ML Foyer / Dining: stone top {{stone}} above the subfloor (FFL {{ffl}} + 8"). We draw the panels standing on the stone, joint 10 under the ceiling: {{h('P03')}} high (your 3188). Please confirm the panel heights.

Stone baseboard by others: {{stn['t']}} thick, top {{stone}} above the subfloor, notch {{stn['notch']}} x {{stn['notch']}}, back cut {{stn['back_cut']}} in front of the door frame; none under the safe cabinet doors (they run to FFL + 10). Finished floor taken at {{ffl}} above the subfloor (as the main level) - please confirm FFL in Bedroom 3.

Panel layout: your DWG REV 1 shows two layouts - 'Bedroom 3 wall to Bathroom and Safe' (horizontal joint at 2383 / 2393) and 'Bedroom 3' panels 1-8 (full height). We use 1-8, full height, sized to the UCON survey (wall {{@s['walls'][0]['L']}} x {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}}; your 5781 x 3195): P01 {{w('P01')}}, P03 {{w('P03')}}, P04 {{w('P04')}}, P05 {{w('P05')}}, P07 {{w('P07')}} x {{h('P03')}}; over the safe ONE piece P02 {{w('P02')}} x {{h('P02')}} (your PDF REV 2: 'this panel should be one piece'); over the door P06 {{w('P06')}} x {{h('P06')}}. Your panel 8 (base under the safe door) is dropped - the stone runs there. Sizes per A-701 replace your cut list.

Safe niche per UCON survey {{ow('SAFE')}} x {{oh('SAFE') - op('SAFE')['z0']}} from {{op('SAFE')['z0']}} above the subfloor, {{op('SAFE')['depth'] || 663}} deep. Instead of your push door on a 290 base: an ordinary TWO-DOOR cabinet WITHOUT a back panel, only two back rails to hold it together in transport (a technical cabinet, as for an oven). Carcass = niche less 3 on every side: {{ow('SAFE') - 6}} x {{oh('SAFE') - op('SAFE')['z0'] - 6}}, from {{op('SAFE')['z0'] + 3}}, 18 sides / top / bottom. Doors 22, flush with the wall panels, two leaves 3 apart, {{pn('P02')['s1'] - pn('P02')['s0']}} overall, from FFL + 10 = {{ffl + 10}} to {{pn('P02')['z0'] - 10}}, 10 joints to the panels; P02 over it in one piece. Please confirm the construction, hinges (your note: no alignment tuning on one part) and the opening hardware (push-to-open or handle).

DO NOT ORDER the safe cabinet before the safe is specified: please send the safe model, its outside dimensions, weight, door swing / hinge side and the clearance it needs to open, and how it is anchored. The cabinet and its doors will be resized to the safe if needed.

Door D01 (right handed, ROVERE SBIANCATO, handle + lock ASTRID by Mandelli 1953 by the client): opening per UCON survey {{ow('D01')}} x {{oh('D01')}} above the SUBFLOOR = {{oh('D01') - ffl}} above FFL. Your frame 989 x 2476 and leaf 878 x 2390 do not fit that height. Drawn as our REC-LAU door D01 (same TM concealed frame on a 170 wall): frame {{ow('D01') - 2 * dr('D01')['gap_side']}} wide, head {{dr('D01')['head_z'][1]}}, cladding {{op('D01')['clad'][1] - op('D01')['clad'][0]}} x {{op('D01')['clad'][3] - op('D01')['clad'][2]}} from {{op('D01')['clad'][2]}}; panels {{rebated}} pass in front of the frame with the rear {{bu['rebate']}} rebate (your 'boiserie alignment panel 5 / 6 / 7'). Please issue the door to these sizes or confirm yours.
Wall thickness at the door taken as {{dr('D01')['wall_t']}} (your door section) - not surveyed. Please confirm before the frame is ordered.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male).

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the SUBFLOOR (FFL {{ffl}}). Dimensions per UCON survey govern; from the TM drawings (order 252258, DWG REV 1 / PDF REV 2) the layout 1-8 and the door profile.

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM; joints 10; on the stone baseboard {{stone}} (by others, Q1 / Q2), 10 to the ceiling and wall corners. Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}. Numbers P01..P07 = TM 1-7 (Q3).

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703), from the stone top; a frame member behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint. Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes by UCON CNC.

Door D01: TM concealed frame, opens into the Bathroom (away from the panels), panel cladding; frame to our survey (Q6, Q7). Panels {{rebated}} rebated at the back {{bu['rebate']}} over the frame, as our other AP walls.

Safe: TM two-door technical cabinet without a back in the niche (carcass = niche - 3 each side), doors 22 flush with the panels to FFL + 10, P02 over it in one piece (Q4). DO NOT ORDER the safe cabinet before the safe specification and dimensions are received (Q5).
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.

A-3:*: Panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM; joints 10; full height {{z0('P03')}}..{{z1('P03')}} on the stone; over the safe cabinet P02 one piece, over the door P06. Numbers = TM 1-7 (Q3).

SAFE CABINET (TM): two doors 22 to FFL + 10, no back, carcass = niche - 3 each side (Q4). DO NOT ORDER before the safe spec and dimensions are received (Q5).
A-5:*: {d}: TM concealed door, profile as REC-LAU D01 (TM), opening per UCON survey {{ow('{d}')}} x {{oh('{d}')}} (Q6).
Right handed, opens into the Bathroom; handle + lock ASTRID by Mandelli 1953 by the client.
